live: Candle/line, wheel zoom, accessible crosshair inspector/OHLCV table, fullscreen/exit and reset exercised on live candles.
Retained Activity reads genuine recent official-pool swaps, UTC timestamps, executed legs and transaction links.

All old Labs hashes safely become #trade; no Labs links or requests. Swap buy/sell/amount/slippage, unsigned wallet sheet, claims guards, 17 ladder levels through $50M, treasury identity and whitepaper retained.
390px emulated touch: native canvas pinch zoom changed the visible time range.
Page reload restores saved source/index data and resumes an incremental mainnet replay.
faultInjection: Injected unsupported fullscreen API: expanded chart contains focus, makes background inert, and Escape restores the page.
Injected GeckoTerminal HTTP 429 preserves timestamped cached candles; explicit retry recovers to live data.
Injected valid pool-identity metadata and empty OHLCV show an honest empty chart with no generated candles or volume.
Injected HTTP 503 on both RPCs shows a recoverable chart error; restoring live RPC and retry recovers real candles and mainnet state.
limitations: No wallet transaction, signature, approval or paid service was used. Physical devices, native iOS/Safari and screen readers were not tested. Fault-injected states are synthetic and are not live-data evidence.
